brief:
An advertisement for nine-day Israeli tourism tours appeared in the LA Times while Israel is engaged in wars with several countries in the region, according to Middle East Eye. The ad promoted travel to Israel without depicting occupied Palestinian territories on its map.

The placement comes amid escalating regional conflict involving Israel and multiple neighboring states. Details about the ad's specific content and the tourism company behind it were not immediately available.

title: LA Times runs Israeli tourism ad erasing Palestinian territories
